description: Quote the exact Gold price to unwrap the UVs of one of the user's 3D models with Tripo Smart UV. Tripo Smart UV refuses a model with more than 80,000 triangles, so clean up a raw generated model first (chargen_edit_3d_cleanup can unwrap UVs in the same pass). Price: 30 Gold. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_edit_3d_uv with the same inputs and quote_token.

keep_textures.description: Keep the textures on the result (default true). Free.

model_id.description: A 3D model from the user's own gallery: an image_id from chargen_search_gallery with media_type model_3d, or a finished 3D job's image_id.

name: chargen_quote_3d_uv
title: Quote 3D UV unwrap
